label: U-Neckline
description: A waistcoat with a low, U-shaped (horseshoe) neckline that opens wide and deep, exposing a large expanse of shirt front. Traditionally associated with formal evening and morning dress, it frames a bow tie or dress shirt elegantly. The scooped opening reads as the most formal and ceremonial neckline.
